text: In four eighty BC, a few thousand Greeks blocked the road into Greece.
sub: In 480 BC, a few thousand Greeks blocked the road into Greece.

text: Marching south was the army of Persia, the largest empire of its time.

text: They chose a pass called Thermopylae. The Hot Gates.

text: Mountains on one side. The sea on the other.

text: At its narrowest, Herodotus says, there was room for just one cart.

text: About seven thousand Greeks, with three hundred Spartans, held it for two days.

text: Then a local man showed the Persians a path over the mountain.
